summary: Titled mutual but operatively one-way against Halyard: LedgerFlow-only definition and obligations, one-way indemnity, one-way equitable relief and assignment, plus personal data and narrowed carve-outs.

findings.quote: disclosed by or on behalf of LedgerFlow to Halyard in connection with the Purpose
findings.why: Titled mutual, but Confidential Information covers only LedgerFlow's disclosures to Halyard, so only the counterparty is protected.
findings.draft_redline: Confidential Information means any information of a confidential or proprietary nature disclosed by or on behalf of either Party (the Disclosing Party) to the other Party (the Receiving Party) in connection with the Purpose.
findings.note_to_counterparty: As this is a mutual NDA, please let us make the definition and the obligations apply equally to both Parties.

findings.why: All operative confidentiality obligations bind only Halyard, not LedgerFlow, despite the mutual title and recital.
findings.draft_redline: Each Receiving Party undertakes to the Disclosing Party that it shall: ...
findings.note_to_counterparty: We would like the undertakings to bind both Parties equally, in line with the mutual title of the agreement.

findings.quote: client transaction records, user identity data and associated individual account holder personal data
findings.why: The definition indicates end-user and account holder personal data will be shared, with no data protection terms or DPA commitment.
findings.draft_redline: Delete the personal data references; add that no personal data beyond business contact details is to be shared before a separate data processing or sharing agreement is in place.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please remove the reference to personal data; we would need a separate data processing agreement before any such data is shared.

findings.quote: the evaluation, testing and discussion of the Purpose between the Parties
findings.why: Use is limited to evaluation of a named potential integration relationship.
findings.fallback_cited: Purpose limited to a named project, product evaluation or pilot.

findings.quote: can clearly establish by contemporaneous written records
findings.why: Evidence standard of contemporaneous written records on a clearly-establish test is stricter than the acceptable written records or reasonable evidence standard.
findings.draft_redline: The obligations in Clause 2 shall not apply to any information that the Receiving Party can establish by written records or other reasonable evidence:
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please allow the standard written records or reasonable evidence test for the exclusions.

findings.quote: is independently developed by employees or contractors of Halyard who have had no access to, knowledge of, or reference to the Confidential Information
findings.why: The independent development carve-out is narrowed by requiring developers to have had no access to, knowledge of or reference to the information.
findings.draft_redline: is independently developed by or for the Receiving Party without use of or reference to the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information;
findings.note_to_counterparty: We suggest the independent development exclusion apply wherever the information is developed without use of the Confidential Information.

findings.quote: directors, officers, employees, professional legal advisers, accountants and authorized technical contractors directly involved in assessing the Purpose
findings.why: Representatives omit Group members and insurers, and there is no consent mechanism for Group disclosure (2.1.1 requires consent for any third party).
findings.draft_redline: Representatives means, in respect of a Party, its and its Group members' directors, officers, employees, professional advisers, auditors and insurers who need to know the information for the Purpose.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please allow disclosure on a need-to-know basis to Group members and to auditors and insurers, with the recipient remaining liable for them.

findings.quote: Halyard may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by an order of a court of competent jurisdiction or by any applicable statutory, regulatory or governmental body.
findings.why: Compelled disclosure permitted, with notice only to the extent legally permissible and no obligation to resist at own cost.

findings.quote: Halyard shall within five (5) Business Days:
findings.why: Five Business Days is within the acceptable period; 5.2 gives the backup and legal-retention exception and director certification is acceptable.
findings.fallback_cited: Any period of 5 Business Days or more.

findings.quote: other than the limited right to use the Confidential Information strictly for the Permitted Purpose
findings.why: All IP stays with the owner and the only licence is use for the Permitted Purpose.

findings.quote: provided on an "as is" basis without warranty of any kind
findings.why: Information is provided as is with no warranty as to accuracy or completeness.

findings.quote: Halyard shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless LedgerFlow
findings.why: A one-way indemnity from Halyard for any breach is a deviation; the preferred position is no indemnity.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 7.1 and the reference to indemnity in clause 8.2.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are unable to agree an indemnity; liability for breach is left to general law.

findings.quote: continue in force for a period of twelve (12) months
findings.why: A 12 month term is within the acceptable 1 to 3 years, with a 30 day mutual early termination right.

findings.quote: for a period of three (3) years following the date of termination or expiry
findings.why: Three-year survival matches the preferred position.

findings.quote: LedgerFlow shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief, specific performance or other equitable remedies
findings.why: Equitable relief is given to LedgerFlow only, so Halyard has no equivalent right.
findings.draft_redline: The Parties acknowledge that damages alone may not be an adequate remedy and each Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief, specific performance or other equitable remedies, and remedies are cumulative.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please make the equitable relief clause mutual.

findings.quote: shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales
findings.why: English law with exclusive jurisdiction of the English courts is the preferred position.

findings.quote: LedgerFlow may at any time assign, novate, transfer, mortgage, charge, subcontract or deal in any other manner with all or any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement to any affiliate or successor entity without the consent of Halyard.
findings.why: LedgerFlow may assign freely while Halyard needs consent.
findings.draft_redline: Neither Party may assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please make the assignment clause mutual, with consent required from both Parties.

findings.quote: shall cooperate fully with LedgerFlow to mitigate and remedy the effects of any such occurrence
findings.why: A one-way duty to notify of suspected breaches and cooperate fully is not covered by the playbook; it binds only Halyard.
findings.draft_redline: Make the notification and cooperation obligation mutual and limit cooperation to reasonable steps at the Disclosing Party's cost.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please make the incident notification obligation mutual and reasonable in scope.
